question: Based on our customer pizza order information, summarize the total quantity of each ingredient used in the pizzas we delivered. Output the name and quantity for each ingredient.
sql:
-- Full query: count each pizza item row (no dedup) for delivered orders
WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT order_id 
    FROM pizza_clean_runner_orders 
    WHERE pickup_time IS NOT NULL
),
pizza_items AS (
    SELECT order_id, pizza_id
    FROM pizza_clean_customer_orders
    WHERE order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM delivered_orders)
),
standard_toppings AS (
    SELECT pi.order_id, pi.pizza_id, TRIM(t.val) as topping_id
    FROM pizza_items pi
    JOIN pizza_recipes pr ON pi.pizza_id = pr.pizza_id
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(string_split(pr.toppings, ', ')) AS t(val)
),
extra_toppings AS (
    SELECT pge.order_id, pge.extras as topping_id
    FROM pizza_get_extras pge
    WHERE pge.order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM delivered_orders)
),
all_toppings AS (
    SELECT topping_id FROM standard_toppings
    UNION ALL
    SELECT topping_id FROM extra_toppings
)
SELECT 
    pt.topping_name,
    COUNT(*) as quantity
FROM all_toppings, pizza_toppings pt
WHERE TRY_CAST(all_toppings.topping_id AS INTEGER) = pt.topping_id
GROUP BY pt.topping_name
ORDER BY pt.topping_name
